Delhi releases second list for EWS admissions, over 8,900 children allocated schools

Delhi has released the second merit list for admissions under the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and disadvantaged groups. The second draw has allocated schools for 8,976 children. This list is for entry-level admissions in the city.
